Its open rooftop is a great spot for watching the sunset, and evenings turn cooler, so warm clothing is recommended (blankets are available on request). It is open most days from 4 pm until 4 am. Contact: 0552373888.

It has comfortable indoor and outdoor seating, including an open rooftop with a pleasant view. It sits in a complex of several restaurants and cafes on Wadi Wajj Road and is a popular choice for an open breakfast at certain times, alongside its regular menu. No fixed opening hours are announced. Contact: 0547018954.

Located in the Miral Oasis Villas in the Al Radf area, it is a favorite among lovers of authentic Italian cuisine in Taif. It is open daily from 1 pm until around midnight. Contact: 0506097222.

It offers quick service and seating suitable for families. No fixed opening hours are announced, so it is best to call before visiting on 0553184759.

It is known for its halloumi croissant, flat white and pastries baked fresh daily, filling the place with their aroma; the cafe is small but elegantly designed. It is open most days from 6 am until 3 pm (closed on Fridays). Contact: 0537070647.

Its signature dishes include maqlaqal and a delicious qalaba, and the restaurant takes care to give families a warm welcome. It is open most days from 5 am until midnight (on Fridays it opens in two sessions). Contact: 0534040959.

It is known for its Turkish and Middle Eastern dishes, and pancakes are among the visitors' favorites. It is open most days from 6 am until midnight (with a short afternoon closure on some days). For inquiries: 0127252150.

98071106.s: Pop Kart at Al Hadban Park in Al Shafa is a thrilling experience for speed lovers, with small cars racing on a dedicated track amid the cool mountain air that characterizes Al Shafa. A single ride is short but fun, and visiting late in the evening is recommended to avoid crowds in peak season.

98071105.s: Taif Rose Farm is an enchanting natural destination offering some of the finest Taif rose fields in a peaceful setting, with the roses blooming each spring. Visitors can watch rose farmers at work harvesting the flowers, and enjoy a countryside breakfast made with fresh ingredients from the farm itself, along with a glimpse of Taif's heritage and its renown for agricultural products. The farm is open most days from 6:30 am until 10:30 pm, and visiting early in the morning is recommended to avoid crowds and enjoy the place at its best.

98071104.s: The Park Mall is a luxury shopping destination with a French character, the first mall of its kind in Taif, strategically located opposite Taif University and near the airport. It features landscaped green spaces that add a calm atmosphere amid the bustle of shopping, along with a range of shops, restaurants and cafes. The mall is open daily from 9 am until around 11 pm (opening at 1 pm on Fridays), and an evening visit is recommended in summer for milder weather.

The mall is open daily from 9 am until around 11 pm (opening at 1 pm on Fridays), and an evening visit is recommended in summer for milder weather.

98071103.s: Jouri Mall is one of the largest shopping centers in Taif in both size and variety, with a wide range of international and local brands, plus many restaurants and cafes and an active nightlife, especially on weekends. It has spacious shaded parking and is an ideal choice for a complete shopping experience in one place. It is open daily from around 10 am until 11 pm (opening at 2 pm on Fridays).

98071103.a: Khalid ibn Al Walid Road, Al Jal, Taif 26523

98071101.s: Tera Mall is one of Taif's leading shopping destinations, with an elegant French-style architectural design that brings together international and local stores, restaurants and a variety of cafes. It is known for its distinctive facade and small tower reminiscent of European landmarks, which makes it a popular spot for photos. The mall has two main sections and a large restaurant and cafe area, and is open daily from 8:30 am until around 1 am, making it a good place for a family evening of shopping and dining.

98070988.s: A huge sports stadium that hosts major matches and sporting events, and a standout destination for football fans. Opening hours: 9:00 am to 6:00 pm.
98070988.b: King Abdullah Sports City is a huge sports stadium that hosts major matches and sporting events, and a standout destination for football fans who want to watch international stars. It offers snack and drink kiosks inside the stands, plenty of restrooms and water refill stations, and is highly rated for the quality of its facilities and the ease of entry procedures. Opening hours are 9:00 am to 6:00 pm (until 5:00 pm on weekends).
98070988.a: Prince Talal bin Mansour Road, King Abdulaziz International Airport, Jeddah 23737

98070987.s: It overlooks the tallest fountain in the world and has seating areas and children's play areas, as well as kiosks selling refreshments and food. Open 24 hours.
98070987.b: Middle Corniche Park overlooks the tallest fountain in the world and has seating areas and children's play areas, as well as kiosks selling refreshments and food. A morning visit is recommended to enjoy watching birds and fish. There is a mosque, restrooms and comfortable seating, and the park is open around the clock, every day of the week.
98070987.a: 2403, Sub Corniche Road, Al Hamra, Jeddah 23321

98070986.s: It holds the title of the tallest fountain in the world, as recognized by Guinness World Records. Opening hours: 9:00 am to 12:00 am (varies by day).
98070986.b: King Fahd's Fountain holds the title of the tallest fountain in the world, as recognized by Guinness World Records, rising about 260 meters and visible from far away. The fountain show usually begins at 5:30 pm and is a magical experience, especially at sunset with its colorful night lighting. Arriving early is recommended to find a good place to sit along the Corniche.

98070977.s: It has a large number of distinctive shops and restaurants, as well as a children's play area. Shopping complex. Contact: 0122754562. Opening hours: 10:00 am to 12:00 am.
98070977.b: Stars Avenue has a large number of distinctive shops and restaurants, as well as a children's play area. It is close to the sea, an AMC cinema and a fitness club, and serves a variety of English, Arabic and Italian food. Contact: 0122754562. Opening hours are 10:00 am to 12:00 midnight.
98070977.a: King Abdulaziz Road, Al Zahra, Jeddah 23424

98070976.s: Al Marwah Plaza has a variety of showrooms and distinctive restaurants and is located in the Al Marwah district. It includes Starbucks, Faris breakfast restaurant, Costa Coffee, McDonald's and Albaik, with a layout that is easy to walk around, although some visitors note that the exits can sometimes be confusing. Opening hours are 6:00 am to 11:00 pm.
98070976.b: Al Marwah Plaza has a variety of showrooms and distinctive restaurants and is located in the Al Marwah district. It includes Starbucks, Faris breakfast restaurant, Costa Coffee, McDonald's and Albaik, with a layout that is easy to walk around, although some visitors note that the exits can sometimes be confusing. 98070974.s: It has a distinctive selection of restaurants and cafes with a lively, contemporary style. Shopping complex.
98070974.b: Skywalk has a distinctive selection of restaurants and cafes with a lively, contemporary style. It is known for the Goodhood restaurant and early breakfast offers, and is very popular in the Al Rawdah district as a daily place to meet friends and eat.

98070972.s: A complete destination with every kind of entertainment and leisure, from shopping centers to a cinema, restaurants and cafes. Shopping complex. Opening hours: 8:00 am to 5:00 am.
98070972.b: Town Square is a complete destination with every kind of entertainment and leisure, from shopping centers to a cinema, restaurants and cafes. It includes a Jarir Bookstore, a Lulu Express supermarket and a Vox cinema, and is a favorite place to get several shopping errands done in a single visit. Opening hours are 8:00 am to 5:00 am.

98070971.s: A large, modern shopping center with many well-known retail stores, a supermarket and a food court. Shopping complex. Contact: 8001111771. Opening hours: 9:00 am to 11:30 pm.
98070971.b: Al Andalus Mall is a large, modern shopping center with many well-known retail stores, a supermarket and a food court. It has a cinema and game arcades, and is very popular as an all-round family destination that meets both shopping and entertainment needs. Contact: 8001111771. Opening hours are 9:00 am to 12:00 midnight.
98070971.a: Prince Majid Road, Al Fayhaa, Jeddah 22245

98070970.s: It has a prime, lively location and a varied selection of distinctive international brands. Shopping complex. Contact: 920000262. Opening hours: 10:00 am to 11:00 pm.
98070970.b: Al Salaam Mall has a prime, lively location and a varied selection of distinctive international brands. It offers a complete shopping experience covering clothing, electronics and groceries, along with entertainment facilities such as a children's play area, a fitness club and a cinema. Contact: 920000262. Opening hours are 10:00 am to 11:00 pm.
98070970.a: King Abdullah Road, Al Sulaymaniyah, Jeddah 22251

98070969.s: The Village shines with its modern design and is a comprehensive, varied shopping center and a complete destination for the whole family. Shopping complex. Contact: 920009467. Opening hours: 9:00 am to 11:00 pm.
98070969.b: The Village Mall shines with its modern design and is a comprehensive, varied shopping center and a complete destination for the whole family. It stands out for its elegant blend of an outdoor boulevard and indoor shops, an evening dancing fountain, and cafes such as L&N and Barnes. Contact: 920009467. Opening hours are 9:00 am to 2:00 am.
98070969.a: 5342, Prince Talal bin Mansour Road, Al Asalah, Jeddah 23738

98070968.s: Atelier La Vie Jeddah is a complex of modern, varied restaurants and cafes with distinctive seating, and it also has a luxury cinema. Shopping complex. Opening hours: 7:00 am to 2:00 am.
98070968.b: Atelier La Vie Jeddah is a complex of modern, varied restaurants and cafes with distinctive seating, and it also has a luxury cinema. It includes well-regarded restaurants such as Olive Garden, Brew 92 and L&N, with free parking, and is an upscale destination for special occasions and evenings out. Opening hours are 7:00 am to 2:00 am.

98070967.s: A shopping complex with a varied selection of top restaurants and cafes, offering an enjoyable entertainment experience. Shopping complex. Contact: 0550995551. Open 24 hours.
98070967.b: The Hub Mall is a shopping complex with a varied selection of top restaurants and cafes, offering an enjoyable entertainment experience. It is known for its modern, contemporary design and many cafes, and is open around the clock, every day of the week. Contact: 0550995551.
98070967.a: Prince Sultan Road, Al Salamah, Jeddah 23333

98070966.s: It has a number of areas dedicated to children, restaurants and cafes, along with international stores for shopping lovers. Shopping complex. Contact: 920000262.
98070966.b: Yasmin Mall has a number of areas dedicated to children, restaurants and cafes, along with international stores for shopping lovers. It stands out for its large space, high level of cleanliness and big food court, and its parking includes electric vehicle charging stations. Contact: 920000262. Opening hours are 10:00 am to 11:30 pm.
